entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All the data, specimens, and sample[n]medicine... They're all there inside[n]that case.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Let me know if you need anything else.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Based on what I read in the findings[n]summary you sent me, the results are[n]truly amazing.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: We'll perform one final exam with our[n]equipment and we'll be ready to treat[n]Miwa-chan with it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Excellent. Then the rest is up to you.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: So, this is the kid from your study, hm?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yes, he's my little guinea pig.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: You certainly walked a dangerous line,[n]but I'm sure you implemented the strictest[n]of safety protocols.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Please put some thought into the offer[n]we discussed, will you? All right, I'll[n]call you later.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He's the doctor treating Miwa-chan.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He just so happened to be a year ahead[n]of me in college.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I told him everything since I was so close[n]to perfecting the medicine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I have to thank you again. All this is thanks[n]to you helping me with the clinical trials.
Don't worry about it.
It was for my exams.
It was rough.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Then I guess I won't.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Riiight.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Your entrance exams, huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I bet.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Although it was really fun for me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: From my tour of their medical facility[n]and discussions I had with their[n]development team...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm confident this will be a success,[n]and they'll complete development[n]on schedule.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The final result will be out of my hands[n]though... if I don't accept their offer,[n]that is.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was... recruited.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He offered me the position of head[n]of research and development at his[n]hospital.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Which means I'll have to close my[n]practice.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I start first thing next month. [n]Unfortunately, Takemi Clinic of[n]Internal Medicine will be gone.
That's troubling.
And your patients?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Really? Because of your entrance exams?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll urge my patients to transfer to that[n]hospital, and I'll be sure to give them[n]priority there.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hehe... You seem flustered. Are you really[n]that troubled by it?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Just kidding.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The part about being recruited is true,[n]but I don't intend to close my practice.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I kind of like being a general practitioner.[n]I'll still work with them to develop new[n]medicine though.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Once the medicine's perfected, I'll be[n]able to see Miwa-chan... and receive[n]my reward: her smile.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh, I need to give you your reward too.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll think of something to give my little[n]guinea pig for holding up his end of[n]the deal.
It feels like my bond with Takemi[n]is growing even deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Такемі[n]стає ще глибшим...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You were really concerned when you[n]thought I was going to close this office.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I know you said it was for your entrance[n]exams, but come on, really?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I think it's about time you started being[n]honest with me. It's okay. You can tell me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Why did you keep coming to me?
I should choose my words carefully...
I should choose my[n]words carefully...
I'm already [clr 2]in a relationship with[n]another girl[clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Why don't you tell me the truth about[n]why you kept coming to me?
I wanted to see you.
It was for my exams.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Really now... Why did you want to[n]see me?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Don't tell me you're in love with me[n]or something.
I love you.[clr 27]
What do you think?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yeah, yeah, sure. Thank you very much.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Now, go on home before it gets dark.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Or... I can give you a "special examination"[n]if you'd like.
It isn't a joke.[clr 27]
That sounds good.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Wait, you're... serious.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Then... I guess I owe you a serious[n]answer too.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Actually, I changed my mind.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I mean, you're in high school, you know?[n]You're my little guinea pig from the[n]clinical trials...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: And you're a kid who lied about his[n]entrance exams to get unlicensed[n]medicine...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Falling in love with someone like that...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's just... unheard of.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm... not sure how I'd proceed with[n]a minor.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: A-Anyway... let's talk[n]about it later... okay?
I formed a special relationship[n]with Takemi...
There's no turning back now...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll see you later, then.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm kidding. Sheesh... you young guys.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That did put a smile on my face though.[n]So thanks for that.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's getting late... You should get going.[n]Come visit anytime.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're surprisingly indecisive.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That did put a smile on my face though.[n]So thanks for that.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's getting late... You should get going.[n]Come visit anytime.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're really kind. Or, perhaps faithful[n]is a better word?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Thank you for sharing how you feel.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's getting late... You should get going.[n]Come visit anytime.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, I can take a hint.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's getting late... You should get going.[n]Come visit anytime.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll see you later.
